hero.description: Point your camera or upload a menu photo. Universal Menu Translator decodes foreign scripts, reveals authentic culinary techniques, explains ingredients, and audits allergens using 100% private on-device local AI.
hero.rotateTooltip: Rotate photo orientation if menu was taken sideways
hero.privacyBadge: 100% private on-device local vision model • Zero data sent to the cloud

demos.title: Explore menus from around the world
demos.description: Try the translator with a sample menu before uploading your own. Instant, zero wait.

dropzone.idleTitle: Drop menu photo or click to browse
dropzone.sub: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP up to 15MB

steps.title: How it works in three steps
steps.step1Desc: Snap a photo in any lighting. 90° rotation handles sideways menus.
steps.step2Desc: Choose target language and set personal dietary restrictions.
steps.step3Desc: Listen to authentic pronunciation and audit verified ingredient claims.

results.noDishesDesc: Try clearing your search query or dietary filters.
results.noLegibleDishes: No legible dishes could be extracted from this photo. If your menu was photographed sideways, try rotating it 90° before scanning, or explore our pre-loaded demo menus.
results.noDescription: No description provided on the menu

camera.viewfinderSub: Align printed dishes and prices inside the frame
camera.promptNotice: Please click 'Allow' if your browser prompts for camera access.

offline.offlineDesc: Cannot connect to FastAPI backend at port 8001. Ensure the backend server is running.
offline.modelInit: Local AI vision model (qwen3-vl:8b) is initializing. Please wait.

errors.unsupportedFile: Unsupported file type '{type}'. Please upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo.
errors.fileTooLarge: File is too large ({size} MB). Maximum allowed upload size is {max} MB.
errors.pipelineTimeout: Analysis timed out: the local model took too long to process this image. Try orienting the photo upright or using a clearer menu shot.
errors.modelUnavailable: Local AI vision model service is unavailable. Please verify Ollama is running ('ollama serve').
errors.invalidImage: Could not decode image. Please provide a valid JPEG, PNG, or WebP menu photo.
errors.networkError: Cannot reach Menu Translator backend on port 8001. Please verify the backend service is running.
